current_app.label: PMP Current v11 with true same-shell Continuous Run Dashboard page

user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.
home_screen_rule: Install pmp-app-current.html once. It is a stable map-driven door and should change as little as possible.
update_rule: Stop stacking visual fixes. Current v11 does not load pmp-visual-scale-contrast-reset-v1.js and no longer opens a separate hardcoded standalone dashboard shell. The Continuous Run Dashboard is now injected as a true same-shell screen/page by pmp-continuous-run-dashboard-inline-native-v1.js, so it inherits the existing app visual owner, card style, button style, Launcher/Resident shell, and bottom navigation while moving content below Launcher/Resident. This does not start Packet 1.5 or weaken free-only gates.
